title: HubSpot vs ActiveCampaign (2027): CRM-First Suite or Automation-First Email Tool, Prices, Free Plan, Startup Discounts and Which One Fits Your Startup

facts.fact: HubSpot's free plan is for up to 2 users, requires no credit card, and includes 2,000 email sends a month with HubSpot branding (vendor's own statement).
facts.quote: Free plan for up to 2 users, no credit card; 2,000 email sends a month with HubSpot branding

facts.fact: HubSpot Starter costs $7 per seat a month on annual billing as a limited-time offer for new customers, with $20 shown as the regular price (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Starter $7 per seat a month (limited-time new-customer offer; $20 shown as the regular price)

facts.fact: HubSpot Starter's regular price is shown as $20 per seat a month, outside the limited-time new-customer offer (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: $20 shown as the regular price

facts.fact: HubSpot Professional starts at $800 a month on annual billing and includes 3 seats (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Professional from $800 a month (3 seats)

facts.fact: HubSpot Enterprise starts at $3,600 a month on annual billing and includes 5 seats (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Enterprise from $3,600 a month (5 seats)

facts.fact: HubSpot charges a one-time onboarding fee of $3,000 for Professional and $7,000 for Enterprise (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Professional $3,000, Enterprise $7,000 one-time onboarding

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign has no free plan and offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee (vendor's own terms).
facts.quote: No free plan; 14-day free trial, no credit card; 30-day money-back guarantee

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign Starter costs $15 a month on annual billing for 1,000 contacts (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 a month for 1,000 contacts

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign Plus costs $49 a month on annual billing for 1,000 contacts (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 a month for 1,000 contacts

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign Pro costs $79 a month on annual billing for 1,000 contacts (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 a month for 1,000 contacts

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign Enterprise costs $145 a month on annual billing for 1,000 contacts (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 a month for 1,000 contacts

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign lists no setup fees on its pricing.
facts.quote: Setup fees | Professional $3,000, Enterprise $7,000 one-time onboarding | None listed

facts.fact: HubSpot's free plan allows 1 automated action, Starter allows up to 10, and Professional offers unlimited omni-channel automation (vendor's own feature limits).
facts.quote: 1 automated action (Free), up to 10 (Starter), unlimited and omni-channel (Professional)

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's Starter plan allows 5 actions per automation, with unlimited actions from Plus (vendor's own feature limits).
facts.quote: 5 actions per automation (Starter), unlimited from Plus; 950+ automation recipes

facts.fact: HubSpot's Starter tier includes 1,000 marketing contacts and sends 5 times the contact tier per month (vendor's own limits).
facts.quote: 1,000 marketing contacts on Starter; sends 5x (Starter), 10x (Pro) or 20x (Enterprise) the contact tier a month

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign allows sends of 10 times the contact limit on Starter and Plus, 12 times on Pro and 15 times on Enterprise (vendor's own limits).
facts.unit: times contact limit (sends, Starter and Plus)
facts.quote: sends 10x (Starter, Plus), 12x (Pro) or 15x (Enterprise) the contact limit

facts.fact: HubSpot Breeze AI credits are 500 on Starter, 3,000 on Pro and 5,000 on Enterprise (vendor's own allowances).
facts.quote: Breeze AI agents and features paid with HubSpot Credits: 500 (Starter), 3,000 (Pro), 5,000 (Enterprise)

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign includes 500 AI credits on every plan (vendor's own allowance).
facts.quote: Active Intelligence on every plan with 500 AI credits

facts.fact: HubSpot offers over 2,000 apps in its integrations (vendor's own count).
facts.quote: Over 2,000 apps

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign lists 1,000+ integrations (vendor's own count).
facts.quote: 1,000+ integrations, Zapier, Claude and ChatGPT via MCP

facts.fact: HubSpot for Startups offers up to 90% off Professional or Enterprise in year one (vendor's startup programme).
facts.quote: HubSpot for Startups: up to 90% off Professional or Enterprise in year one

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign Incubator offers 90% off any annual plan in year one (vendor's startup programme).
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign Incubator: 90% off any annual plan in year one
